card.name: Citation details and dates in science news
card.fires_on: Words and digits inside journal-style citations and dates, such as 'al.' after 'et', digits of a year or volume, 'c.' before a year. Also some linking words in science news prose.

modes.label: Citation pieces
modes.description: The 'al' after 'et' or the digits of volume and page numbers in a journal reference.

modes.label: Dates and years
modes.description: A digit in a decade or year, a month name, or 'c.' before a year.

modes.label: Linking words in news prose
modes.description: A connecting word or place name partway through a sentence in science or environment news.
modes.example: in a UN report from<< July>> last year

card.plain: It fires inside reference citations and dates in science news articles, on the small pieces like 'al.' and year digits.
